name: OzEmail
summary: Major early Australian ISP; listed on NASDAQ (1996) and ASX; bought by MCI WorldCom in 1999; retail assets sold to iiNet in 2005 (FEDORA (2500) PTY LIMITED, ACN 066 387 157).

events.details: Founded by Sean Howard as Oz-E-mail; relaunched as ISP OzEmail in 1994.
Retail/internet assets acquired by iiNet on 28 Feb 2005; brand discontinued.
